author: Aman Darshan
review_text: I’m constantly frustrated by the app’s inability to recognize my device after I log out. Every time I log back in, the app acts like it’s a new device, and I have to go through the process of sending an OTP. As someone living abroad, this means I have to enable roaming and incur extra charges just to receive the OTP. It’s an unnecessary hassle, especially when my device is already registered. Please fix this issue and offer alternative ways to receive OTPs, like email verification.
